title: Forja model family
description: family.yaml: one isolated environment for the models of one family, with the upstream code it runs pinned by commit and sha256.

name.description: The family's name; its environment is <data>/envs/<name>. Must match the folder and the manifests' family.

lanes.description: Torch lanes the family installs on; each needs requirements/<lane>.txt.

upstream.description: Upstream model code, downloaded at install time and never committed to Forja.

url.description: An archive of one pinned commit, e.g. https://codeload.github.com/<org>/<repo>/tar.gz/<commit sha>.

build.description: Packages compiled against the installed torch, in order; {upstream} is the extracted source. A mapping gives each lane its own list; a lane it leaves out builds nothing.

torch_backend.description: uv --torch-backend per lane, e.g. cuda: cu124.

smoke.description: Imports that prove the upstream code and its extensions load; a mapping gives each lane its own.
